prompts.name: SFT Instruction Generator
prompts.use_case: Generate instruction-following pairs from domain text
prompts.template: Generate {{n}} supervised fine-tuning examples from the source text. Return JSONL objects with keys: instruction, input, output, tags, difficulty. Ground every output in source facts only. Domain={{domain}} Source={{source_text}}

prompts.name: Preference Pair Generator
prompts.template: Create {{n}} preference pairs in JSONL. Each row: prompt, chosen, rejected, rationale. chosen must be more accurate, safer, and more useful than rejected. Task={{task}} Context={{context}}

prompts.name: Dataset Cleaning Prompt
prompts.use_case: Normalize and validate existing training records
prompts.template: Clean and normalize the dataset rows. Remove duplicates, redact personal data, fix malformed fields, and standardize tags. Return valid JSONL using schema: instruction, input, output, tags, difficulty, flags. Dataset={{dataset_rows}}

prompts.name: Model Documentation Preference Pairs
prompts.use_case: Train evaluators for model-card and governance quality
prompts.template: Create {{n}} JSONL preference pairs from model docs. Schema: prompt, chosen, rejected, rationale, policy_tags. chosen must be more complete on intended use, limitations, data provenance, metrics, bias, privacy, and monitoring. Document={{model_document_text}}
